results.query: transformer DGA acetylene rising reduce loading contact manufacturer IEEE C57.104 L1 limit 35 ppm too high
results.snippet: Acetylene is the exception; IEEE sets an L1 limit of 35 ppm (too high), and IEC sets acetylene range at 3 to 50. TOA picks the lowest number (3 ppm) and sets the generation rate alarm value at 3 ppm per month. Notes: If one or more gas generation rates are equal to or exceed G1 limits (10% of L1 limits per month), you should begin to pay more attention to this transformer. Reduce the DGA sample interval, reduce loading, plan for future outage, contact the manufacturer etc.
results.title: FIST 3-30 Transformer Maintenance (Bureau of Reclamation, Oct 2000), sec. 4.4 DGA, TOA alarm limits
